question: Should OpenClaw accept this optional bundled Workspaces surface and its approval-gated agent-authored widget execution model after the lifecycle defect, merge conflict, and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The PR adds a large permanent bundled UI, persistence, tool, CLI, and untrusted-code security surface and carries a protected maintainer label; implementation correctness cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor bundled Workspaces
options.body: Accept the opt-in bundled direction, requiring lifecycle cleanup, a clean current-main head, and full exact-head security proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to trusted widgets
options.body: Retain the workspace document, CLI, tools, and built-in widgets while deferring executable custom widgets to a later decision.

options.title: Keep the capability external
options.body: Decline the bundled product and move it to an external plugin if maintainers confirm the current SDK exposes every required seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled Workspaces
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in bundled direction, requiring lifecycle cleanup, a clean current-main head, and full exact-head security proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current branch integrator, security-context participant, and most recent owner across the complete consolidated implementation.
